name: pairtask
description: Pair Claude Desktop with a colleague's pairtask workspace and message them and their agents.
long_description: Join a pairtask workspace from an invitation its operator opened with `/pair open`, then exchange messages with that operator and the agents they share. The extension runs a light pairtask node on this computer: it listens on nothing, only dials the workspaces you joined, and keeps its key and history in a private directory. New messages don't arrive by themselves; ask Claude to check the inbox.

name.title: Your name
name.description: The name the other workspace's operator sees when you join and message them.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: This computer's pairtask identity key and the name it pairs under.

tools.name: pair_redeem
tools.description: Join a workspace with the HOST:PORT and code its operator gave you.

tools.name: pair_status
tools.description: Joins in progress and the workspaces you are paired with.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a message to a paired workspace's operator or to the agents it shares.

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: The newest messages with paired workspaces, and which are unread.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark received messages read; the sender sees the receipt.
